The Executor successfully populated the workbook using precise cell mapping and relative formula referencing to calculate weighted port throughput.
The process involved identifying exact boundaries in the 'Data' sheet to ensure MATCH functions correctly targeted series codes and years. Formulas were applied across three distinct data blocks (H12:L17, H19:L24, H26:L31) to calculate net container flow and weighted means. By writing explicit '=' prefixed strings via openpyxl, the Executor maintained the workbook's formula-driven integrity without using static computed values.
